name: toolkit
description: Optional utilities for the workshop: html-report (report to a polished dark HTML page, from a doc or from session findings), arch-map (derived architecture maps), ui-demo-video (Playwright walkthroughs with verification frames), writing-skills (TDD for skill authoring, derived from obra/superpowers, MIT), and adopt-global-rules (installs the workshop's shipped global CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md and rules onto a machine, additively). Install alongside workbench when you want them; skip to keep sessions lean.
